review_candidates.title: L3 Cloud Services Engineer
review_candidates.description_excerpt: The ideal candidate will bring 5 to 8+ years of relevant experience, particularly in managing and supporting Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD) and distributed systems. This role is instrumental in the administration, implementation, and ongoing support of Microsoft-based infrastructures, with a primary focus on Office 365, Microsoft 365, and Azure. You'll also play a key role in training new clients and maintaining a stable, secure IT environment. Key Responsibilities Provide advanced administration
eligibility_evidence: This is a remote position with hybrid work as needed.

Key Responsibilities Provide advanced administration and support for Office 365, Microsoft 365, and Entra ID (Azure AD) Act as a Level 3 escalation for the IT Service Desk, resolving complex technical issues Collaborate with Cloud Engineers and Architects to support and improve cloud infrastructure
